name: Hang chu wine
summary: Rice wine cooked from the germ of glutinous or ordinary rice and kept for the new year and for weddings.
origin: Bao Lam Dong, 22 Sep 2023, in the Mong section of a Dak Nong food feature.
howToEat: Bao Lam Dong says rượu hang chú is cooked from phôi thóc, the germ of glutinous rice or ordinary rice, and is used on special days such as the new year and weddings.
seoTitle: Ruou hang chu — wedding and new-year wine
seoDescription: Rice wine from glutinous or ordinary rice germ, for the new year and weddings. Bao Lam Dong names it in Dak Nong.
